match_summary.sql:
select count(*) rows, sum(training_eligible=1) training_eligible, min(date) date_min,max(date) date_max,
       sum(home_id=away_id) same_team,sum(h90<0 or a90<0) negative_goals,
       sum(training_eligible=1 and (h90 is null or a90 is null)) eligible_missing_score from matches

eligible_by_competition.sql: select competition,count(*) rows,min(date) date_min,max(date) date_max from matches where training_eligible=1 group by competition

observation_summary.sql:
select count(*) rows,sum(first_known_at is null or first_known_at='') missing_first_known,
       sum(observed_at is null or observed_at='') missing_observed,
       sum(source_id not in (select source_id from sources)) orphan_source_id from observations

duplicate_observation_keys.sql: select count(*) keys from (select provider,source_key,competition,count(*) n from observations group by provider,source_key,competition having count(*)>1)
